reports.title: Review-Report BOB modified USDC bridge library 04.2024 (BOB-02-WP1)
reports.description: Cure53 cryptography review and source code audit of BOB's modified USDC bridge library (L1/L2 USDC bridges, shared UsdcBridge base, UsdcManager and helpers) submitted as PR #1 to the bob-collective/optimism fork. One High front-running finding and one Low finding, both fixed during the assessment and verified by Cure53.

versions.coverage: Full review of the modified USDC bridge library as submitted in bob-collective/optimism PR #1; the report lists PR commits 2ba5514, 12996ea and a80a286, of which a80a286 is the latest and is recorded here. BOB-02-001 (High): initialize() can be front-run to take over a directly deployed bridge.
Remediation of BOB-02-001: initializers disabled on the implementation (init only through proxy); fix verified by Cure53 during the assessment.

Full review of the modified USDC bridge library as submitted in bob-collective/optimism PR #1; the report lists PR commits 2ba5514, 12996ea and a80a286, of which a80a286 is the latest and is recorded here. BOB-02-001 (High) affects this bridge as well.
Remediation of BOB-02-001 through the inherited UsdcBridge base (this file itself is unchanged by the fix commit); fix verified by Cure53.

Full review of the modified USDC bridge library as submitted in bob-collective/optimism PR #1; the report lists PR commits 2ba5514, 12996ea and a80a286, of which a80a286 is the latest and is recorded here. BOB-02-001 (High): __UsdcBridge_init reachable through unprotected initialize().
Remediation of BOB-02-001: _disableInitializers added to the constructor; fix verified by Cure53.

Full review of the modified USDC bridge library as submitted in bob-collective/optimism PR #1; the report lists PR commits 2ba5514, 12996ea and a80a286, of which a80a286 is the latest and is recorded here. Only BOB-02-002 (Low): missing zero-address check in transferUSDCRoles.
Remediation of BOB-02-002: zero owner address rejected; fix verified by Cure53.

reports.title: Veridise Auditing Report for Kailua Protocol (February 2025)
reports.description: Veridise three-week assessment of RISC Zero's Kailua fault-proof framework (smart contracts, off-chain CLI/client/host components and zkVM guest program) at commit 6e2ce8f, which BOB uses as its dispute game. Six Critical and seven High findings were reported; all but one were confirmed fixed in the stated commits and PR #21, with Kona and Zeth dependencies out of scope.

Critical V-KLA-VUL-001/002/003/004/006 and High V-KLA-VUL-007 in KailuaTournament.sol, KailuaLib.sol and KailuaTreasury.sol. The report records the fix for VUL-001 at f402ec3 (documentation-only commit) and for VUL-006 at 871eb34 (touches only crates/common/src/client.rs).
